subject: question about matrix data for pyStan: Column-major vs row major

messages.author: c052ac5727650828
messages.subject: question about matrix data for pyStan: Column-major vs row major
parts:
Hi Everyone,

I have a question about pyStan. Stan accepts matrix data in column-major format while python stores data in row major. I was wondering if I need to do so some conversion before feeding the data in or it is done internally? More specifically, is this correct or I have to reformat X:

code = """
data {
  ....
  matrix[3,3]    X ;
  ....
}
...
"""
X = np.random.rand(3,3)
data = { 'X':X }

....
​
